build_proposal_module: build a ProposalModule for 3D object detection with vote aggregation and proposal generation
run_decode_scores: run decode_scores to extract objectness, center, heading, size, and semantic class scores from network output

refactor_sampling_strategy: refactor the ProposalModule sampling strategy to switch between vote_fps, seed_fps, or random sampling modes
